title: Avoid cells overlapping widgets when deciding initial placement of new icons in desktop containment mode (perhaps optionally)
line: New files on the desktop no longer get placed hidden under widgets.
explanation: In manual arrangement, the desktop's Positioner put each new icon in the first grid cell without an icon, or after the last one. It knew nothing about widgets, so new files (and the first icons on an empty desktop) often landed under a widget and were invisible. Now the desktop view works out which icon cells overlap a widget and passes them to the Positioner as blocked cells; every place that picks a cell for a new icon skips them. Icons that already have a position are never moved.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: don't place new icons under widgets

New desktop icons went to the first free grid cell even when a widget
covered it, so they ended up hidden. The view now tells the positioner
which cells overlap widgets, and new icons skip those cells.

BUG: 374094

media.caption: Notes widget at the top left; 8 files created on the desktop: files 1-3 are hidden under the widget.
Same steps with the fix: the new files start right of the widget.
Ten more files: the next rows also skip the cells under the widget.
Right-aligned icons with the widget at the top right: new files fill from the right, around the widget.
Widget moved over existing icons: they stay where they were; new files 19-22 fill the free cells at the top left.
